front: La dissertation suit un plan en trois parties : thèse, antithèse, synthèse.
pronunciation: [lah dee-sehr-tah-SYOHN swee tan PLAHN ahn trwah par-TEE : TEZ, ahn-tee-TEZ, san-TEZ]
back: The dissertation follows a three-part plan: thesis, antithesis, synthesis.
context: The 'plan dialectique', drilled into every French lycée student.

front: L'introduction comporte une accroche, une problématique et l'annonce du plan.
pronunciation: [lan-troh-dük-SYOHN kohm-port ün nah-KROSH, ün proh-blay-mah-TEEK ay lah-nohns dü PLAHN]
back: The introduction includes a hook, the central question and an outline of the plan.
context: French academic writing announces its structure explicitly.

front: Quelle est la problématique de votre mémoire ?
pronunciation: [kel eh lah proh-blay-mah-TEEK duh voh-truh may-MWAHR]
back: What is the research question of your thesis?
context: 'La problématique' = the central question. 'Un mémoire' (masc.) = a thesis; 'la mémoire' = memory.

front: Dans un premier temps, nous analyserons les causes du phénomène.
pronunciation: [dahn zan pruh-myay TAHN, noo zah-nah-lee-zuh-rohn lay kohz dü fay-noh-MEN]
back: First, we will analyze the causes of the phenomenon.
context: 'Dans un premier temps… dans un second temps' structures a plan. Academic 'nous' = I.

front: Dans un second temps, nous en examinerons les conséquences.
pronunciation: [dahn zan suh-gohn TAHN, noo zahn eg-zah-mee-nuh-rohn lay kohn-say-KAHNS]
back: Secondly, we will examine its consequences.
context: Note 'second' is pronounced 'segond'.

front: Il convient tout d'abord de définir les termes du sujet.
pronunciation: [eel kohn-vyan too dah-BOR duh day-fee-neer lay tehrm dü sü-ZHEH]
back: First of all, the terms of the question need to be defined.
context: 'Il convient de' = it is appropriate to (formal).

front: Il s'agit dès lors de se demander si la liberté est possible sans loi.
pronunciation: [eel sah-zhee deh LOR duh suh duh-mahn-day see lah lee-behr-TAY eh poh-see-bluh sahn LWAH]
back: The question then is whether freedom is possible without law.
context: 'Dès lors' = from then on, consequently.

front: Cette hypothèse mérite d'être nuancée.
pronunciation: [set ee-poh-TEZ may-reet deh-truh nü-ahn-SAY]
back: This hypothesis deserves to be qualified.
context: 'Nuancer' = to qualify, add nuance. A key verb in French argument.

front: Il convient toutefois de relativiser ces résultats.
pronunciation: [eel kohn-vyan toot-FWAH duh ruh-lah-tee-vee-zay say ray-zül-TAH]
back: These results should nevertheless be put into perspective.
context: 'Toutefois' = however, nevertheless.

front: Or, cette affirmation ne résiste pas à l'analyse.
pronunciation: [OR, set ah-feer-mah-SYOHN nuh ray-zeest pah ah lah-nah-LEEZ]
back: Yet this claim doesn't stand up to analysis.
context: 'Or' introduces a new element that challenges what precedes. Not 'gold' here!

front: Ainsi, l'auteur dénonce les dérives de la société de consommation.
pronunciation: [an-SEE, loh-tuhr day-nohns lay day-reev duh lah soh-syay-tay duh kohn-soh-mah-SYOHN]
back: Thus the author denounces the excesses of consumer society.
context: 'Ainsi' at the start = thus. 'Les dérives' = excesses, drift.

front: En effet, les chiffres confirment cette tendance.
pronunciation: [ahn neh-FEH, lay SHEE-fruh kohn-feerm set tahn-DAHNS]
back: Indeed, the figures confirm this trend.
context: 'En effet' justifies the previous statement. It doesn't mean 'in effect'.

front: De surcroît, cette mesure coûterait cher.
pronunciation: [duh sür-KRWAH, set muh-zür koo-tuh-reh SHEHR]
back: Moreover, this measure would be costly.
context: 'De surcroît' = furthermore (formal). Also 'en outre', 'par ailleurs'.

front: Par ailleurs, il faut tenir compte du contexte historique.
pronunciation: [par ah-YUHR, eel foh tuh-neer kohnt dü kohn-tekst ees-toh-REEK]
back: In addition, the historical context must be taken into account.
context: 'Par ailleurs' = moreover, in another respect.

front: Néanmoins, cette position présente des limites.
pronunciation: [nay-ahn-MWAN, set poh-zee-syohn pray-zahnt day lee-MEET]
back: Nonetheless, this position has its limits.
context: 'Néanmoins' = nonetheless.

front: Contrairement à une idée reçue, Napoléon n'était pas petit.
pronunciation: [kohn-trehr-mahn ah ün nee-day ruh-SÜ, nah-poh-lay-OHN nay-teh pah puh-TEE]
back: Contrary to popular belief, Napoleon wasn't short.
context: 'Une idée reçue' = a common misconception.

front: Loin de condamner la science, Rousseau en critique les usages.
pronunciation: [lwan duh kohn-dah-nay lah SYAHNS, roo-SOH ahn kree-teek lay zü-ZAHZH]
back: Far from condemning science, Rousseau criticizes how it is used.
context: 'Loin de' + infinitive = far from.

front: Autrement dit, le progrès n'est pas toujours synonyme de bonheur.
pronunciation: [oh-truh-mahn DEE, luh proh-GREH neh pah too-zhoor see-noh-neem duh boh-NUHR]
back: In other words, progress doesn't always mean happiness.
context: 'Autrement dit' = in other words.

front: Comme le souligne Tocqueville, l'égalité peut menacer la liberté.
pronunciation: [kum luh soo-LEE-nyuh tok-VEEL, lay-gah-lee-TAY puh muh-nah-say lah lee-behr-TAY]
back: As Tocqueville points out, equality can threaten freedom.
context: Introducing a quotation: comme le souligne / l'affirme / le rappelle…

front: Cette citation illustre parfaitement notre propos.
pronunciation: [set see-tah-SYOHN ee-lüs-truh par-fet-MAHN noh-truh proh-POH]
back: This quotation perfectly illustrates our point.
context: 'Le propos' = the point being made.

front: En définitive, la question reste ouverte.
pronunciation: [ahn day-fee-nee-TEEV, lah kes-tyohn rest oo-VEHRT]
back: Ultimately, the question remains open.
context: 'En définitive' = in the final analysis.

front: Au terme de cette analyse, nous pouvons conclure que…
pronunciation: [oh TEHRM duh set ah-nah-LEEZ, noo poo-vohn kohn-klür kuh]
back: At the end of this analysis, we can conclude that…
context: Standard opening of a conclusion.

front: La conclusion doit ouvrir sur une question plus large.
pronunciation: [lah kohn-klü-ZYOHN dwah oo-vreer sür ün kes-tyohn plü LARZH]
back: The conclusion should open onto a wider question.
context: 'L'ouverture' = the final opening, expected in French conclusions.

front: Il faut éviter la paraphrase.
pronunciation: [eel foh ay-vee-tay lah pah-rah-FRAHZ]
back: You must avoid paraphrasing.
context: A frequent teacher's comment in the margin: 'paraphrase !'

front: Votre argumentation manque de rigueur.
pronunciation: [voh-truh ar-gü-mahn-tah-SYOHN mahnk duh ree-GUHR]
back: Your argument lacks rigor.
context: 'La rigueur' is a core French academic value.

front: Il faut citer vos sources en note de bas de page.
pronunciation: [eel foh see-tay voh SOORS ahn not duh bah duh PAHZH]
back: You must cite your sources in footnotes.
context: 'Une note de bas de page' = a footnote.

front: Ce passage relève du plagiat.
pronunciation: [suh pah-SAHZH ruh-lev dü plah-ZHYAH]
back: This passage counts as plagiarism.
context: 'Relever de' = to fall within, be a matter of.

front: Ma soutenance de thèse aura lieu en juin.
pronunciation: [mah soot-NAHNS duh TEZ oh-rah lyuh ahn ZHWAN]
back: My thesis defense will take place in June.
context: 'La soutenance' = the oral defense of a thesis.

front: Le jury m'a posé des questions pointues.
pronunciation: [luh zhü-REE mah poh-zay day kes-tyohn pwan-TÜ]
back: The panel asked me very specialized questions.
context: 'Pointu' = sharp; here, highly specialized.

front: J'ai obtenu la mention très bien.
pronunciation: [zhay ob-tuh-nü lah mahn-syohn treh BYAN]
back: I graduated with highest honors.
context: Mentions: passable, assez bien, bien, très bien. 20/20 is almost never given.

front: Mon exposé portera sur la laïcité.
pronunciation: [mohn nek-spoh-ZAY por-tuh-rah sür lah lah-ee-see-TAY]
back: My presentation will be about secularism.
context: 'Porter sur' = to be about. 'La laïcité' = French secularism, a classic topic.

front: Je vais d'abord présenter le contexte, puis j'aborderai les enjeux.
pronunciation: [zhuh veh dah-bor pray-zahn-tay luh kohn-TEKST, pwee zhah-bor-duh-reh lay zahn-ZHUH]
back: I'll first present the context, then turn to the issues at stake.
context: 'Les enjeux' = what's at stake. 'Aborder' = to tackle a subject.

front: Comme vous pouvez le constater sur cette diapositive…
pronunciation: [kum voo poo-vay luh kohn-stah-TAY sür set dyah-poh-zee-TEEV]
back: As you can see on this slide…
context: 'Une diapo' (informal) = a slide.

front: Je passe maintenant la parole à ma collègue.
pronunciation: [zhuh pas mant-nahn lah pah-ROL ah mah koh-LEG]
back: I'll now hand over to my colleague.
context: 'Passer la parole' = to hand over the floor.

front: J'en viens maintenant à mon deuxième point.
pronunciation: [zhahn vyan mant-NAHN ah mohn duh-zyem PWAN]
back: I now come to my second point.
context: Transition phrase in oral presentations.

front: Si vous me le permettez, j'aimerais revenir sur un point essentiel.
pronunciation: [see voo muh luh pehr-meh-TAY, zheh-muh-reh ruh-vuh-neer sür an pwan eh-sahn-SYEL]
back: If you'll allow me, I'd like to come back to an essential point.
context: 'Revenir sur' = to return to (a point).

front: Je vous remercie de votre attention.
pronunciation: [zhuh voo ruh-mehr-SEE duh voh-trah-tahn-SYOHN]
back: Thank you for your attention.
context: The standard ending of a presentation.

front: Avez-vous des questions ?
pronunciation: [ah-vay-VOO day kes-TYOHN]
back: Do you have any questions?
context: Inviting questions after a talk.

front: C'est une excellente question, merci de l'avoir posée.
pronunciation: [seh tün nek-seh-lahnt kes-TYOHN, mehr-SEE duh lah-vwahr poh-ZAY]
back: That's an excellent question, thank you for asking it.
context: Past participle agreement: 'posée' agrees with 'l'' (= la question) placed before.

front: Je ne suis pas spécialiste de la question, mais je peux vous orienter.
pronunciation: [zhuh nuh swee pah spay-syah-leest duh lah kes-TYOHN, meh zhuh puh voo zoh-ryahn-TAY]
back: I'm not a specialist on the matter, but I can point you in the right direction.
context: An honest way to handle a question outside your field.

front: Le grand oral du bac évalue la capacité à argumenter.
pronunciation: [luh grahn toh-RAL dü BAK ay-vah-lü lah kah-pah-see-TAY ah ar-gü-mahn-TAY]
back: The baccalaureate 'grand oral' assesses the ability to argue a case.
context: A 20-minute oral exam introduced in 2021.

front: Il a fait l'éloge de son ancien professeur.
pronunciation: [ee lah feh lay-LOZH duh sohn nahn-syan proh-feh-SUHR]
back: He paid tribute to his former teacher.
context: 'Faire l'éloge de' = to praise. 'Ancien' before the noun = former.

front: Son discours était d'une clarté remarquable.
pronunciation: [sohn dees-KOOR ay-teh dün klar-TAY ruh-mar-KAH-bluh]
back: His speech was remarkably clear.
context: 'D'une… remarquable' is an elegant way to praise a quality.

front: Ce que l'on conçoit bien s'énonce clairement.
pronunciation: [suh kuh lohn kohn-swah BYAN say-nohns klehr-MAHN]
back: What is well understood is clearly expressed.
context: Boileau (1674). The rest: 'et les mots pour le dire arrivent aisément'.

front: Le style, c'est l'homme même.
pronunciation: [luh STEEL, seh lum MEM]
back: Style is the man himself.
context: Buffon (1753), often quoted about writing.
